description: The top-left plot in Figure 6, labeled “Massive Activation of atten_output_gate,” displays the maximum activation value across layers for four different components: attn_output (blue dashed line), ffn_output (green dash-dot line), attn_residual (orange dotted line), and ffn_residual (red solid line). The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to approximately 22 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” is linear and ranges from 0 to 400, with major ticks every 50 units. All four lines remain near zero for the first 5–6 layers. Starting around layer 6, the ffn_residual (red solid) line begins a steep, accelerating ascent, reaching approximately 380 by layer 22. The attn_residual (orange dotted) line follows a similar but slightly delayed and less steep trajectory, peaking near 300. The attn_output (blue dashed) and ffn_output (green dash-dot) lines show modest, gradual increases, reaching values of approximately 40 and 160, respectively, by layer 22. This pattern visually confirms the caption’s claim that significant massive activations emerge after the 6th layer.
